background_setting: A busy commercial street lined with small shops and storefronts on both sides under a clear blue daytime sky. The right side features a retail shopfront with awnings, glass windows, and the cardboard cutout standing on its sidewalk. Parked cars line the curb, streetlights and utility poles rise along the edges, and pedestrians and signage populate the sidewalks. The asphalt road ahead is clear with painted lane markings, and buildings recede toward a distant vanishing point.

The vehicle continues approaching the shop; the flat, thin cutout is clearly recognized as motionless and on the sidewalk. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows the ego vehicle cruising down a clear commercial street under bright daylight with consistent shadows, a shop and a cardboard cutout appearing ahead on the right sidewalk. By 0:01 the cutout of a smiling suited figure grows larger; the lane ahead remains empty. At 0:02 the vehicle maintains steady speed and the flat, thin, motionless nature of the cutout is evident. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle passes the shop at its normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping, and the cardboard cutout, remaining entirely on the sidewalk, slides past on the right and out of frame while the road ahead stays clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
